x: Bill Lucas presents the Open 7 Miles Walk winning team awards to our Ladies - Gill Brackpool, Jill Borthwick and Sue Morrison. "Centenary" President Bill Lucas and the Mayor of Merton Clr H Turner who graced us with his attendance at the 20mls Run, 7 miles Open Walk and 12 stage Relay.
J.Draka (Brighton) 49.26; 2.B.Sworoski (Sheff) 49.39; 3.S.Spacay 52.27 Also walked - G.Brackpool, S.Morrison Results: 1.Brighton 17; 2.Sheffield 24; 3.Bromsgrove 35.

Other performances of note have been Gill Brackpool's 5th in the National 15kms, Sue Morrison and John Hall winning the Civil Service 3kms. A welcome return to John Llewellin after injury and long lay off and hopefully Paul Warburton making some sort of comeback but regretably no younger faces to the side.

Normally a national championship would merit a good mention, however, the National 10 at Sheffield on March 10th only had two starters from Belgrave, 27th C.Lawton 78.18 and 73rd J.Dunsford 89.22; In the Ladies 15 Kms held over the same tough course Gill Brackpool was 5th in 85.12.
